h1: Lamoon Boutique Trang — the in-town shophouse with rooms bigger than the price suggests
intro: Most places to stay in central Trang are small, standard rooms — but Lamoon Boutique Trang takes a different path · It's a renovated 4-storey shophouse in the Ban Phlu Phli area, with several room types that are larger than you'd expect, and some that sleep a whole group or family · A small 4-star boutique hotel with a garden, a bar, and staff that reviewers rate very highly · From around ฿750/night, scoring 8.1 from real guest reviews.

body.html: Lamoon Boutique Trang occupies a renovated 4-storey shophouse in the Ban Phlu Phli area (Thap Thiang sub-district) of central Trang, reworked into a small boutique hotel · The thing guests mention most is that the rooms are bigger than the price suggests, especially the Studios and the larger group rooms that sleep several people · Many reviewers arrive as a group or family and report getting a far roomier space than expected — better value to share than booking several small rooms.

Room types range from a Queen with garden view, to Twin, Studio and Triple rooms for groups · The clean, attractive bathrooms come up often as a highlight, and many rooms are decorated in warm tones with comfortable beds and cold air-con · Some have a balcony · The catch is that the rooms aren't configured the same way — a few lack a fridge, kettle or desk · One reviewer summed it up: a small fridge and kettle in the room would have made it a perfect ten.
"We came as a group and got a big room, the bathroom was beautiful and clean, and everything was nearby — genuinely good value for a stay in central Trang."

Service is where this place scores highest · Staff earn very high marks — reviewers consistently call them friendly, attentive and helpful, happy to recommend restaurants and sights around town · There's an airport transfer service and help booking tours and tickets · Cleanliness is praised steadily across reviews · The hotel also has a garden, a bar and a relaxed common lounge area to unwind in.

The location is in central Trang's Ban Phlu Phli area, on Phloen Phithak Road · It's about 1.9 km from Trang Clock Tower, with Ratsadanupradit (the city park) within easy walking distance · The streets around it are full of restaurants and cafes — including well-rated spots like Mamma Mia and Green House — close to a hospital and shops · It's roughly 2.5 km from Trang Railway Station and 7 km from Trang Airport · The area is quieter than the old-town core but still keeps the city's food and sights within easy reach.

What to know before you book: because it's a converted shophouse, there's no lift — you'll be using the stairs, so anyone with heavy luggage or who finds stairs difficult should ask for a lower-floor room · Soundproofing isn't great, with reviews mentioning noise from the room next door and, at times, firecrackers from a nearby Chinese shrine · Some showers are on the cramped side, and rooms at the same price can differ in size and layout — so state your preferences when you book.

In short, per real guest sentiment: Lamoon Boutique Trang suits groups and families who want a roomy, good-value base in central Trang and value warm service · Standard rates start around ฿750/night, rising to roughly ฿1,800–2,200 for the larger Studios and group rooms in peak periods — fair value for the room size and service, as long as you accept the no-lift building and that in-room amenities vary by room type.

honestSummary: Lamoon Boutique Trang is the best pick for travellers who come as a group or family, want a roomy, good-value base in central Trang, and value warm service — a renovated shophouse with big rooms, lovely bathrooms and top-rated staff · But accept that there's no lift, soundproofing is weak, and in-room amenities vary by room type.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Lamoon Boutique Trang

faq.q: Where is Lamoon Boutique Trang, and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 39 Phloen Phithak Road in the Ban Phlu Phli area, Thap Thiang, central Trang · Ratsadanupradit city park is within walking distance · It's about 1.9 km from Trang Clock Tower, 2.5 km from Trang Railway Station and 7 km from Trang Airport, with plenty of restaurants and cafes around it.

faq.q: How much does Lamoon Boutique Trang cost, and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿750/night for a Queen/Twin room · Studios and family/group rooms run roughly ฿1,400–2,200 · Prices vary by date and holidays — compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Who is Lamoon Boutique Trang best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for groups and families who want roomy, good-value rooms in central Trang and value warm service · It's a small in-town hotel with no pool or resort facilities, best for travellers who prioritise location and room size over a full amenity list.

faq.q: Does the hotel have a lift, and is it noisy?
faq.a: It's a 4-storey shophouse with no lift, so you'll use the stairs — ask for a lower floor if you have heavy luggage · Soundproofing is weak, with reviews mentioning neighbour noise and firecrackers from a nearby shrine at times, so earplugs are a good idea.

faq.q: Do the rooms have a fridge and kettle?
faq.a: In-room amenities vary by room type — some rooms have no fridge, kettle or desk · If you need them, ask and confirm with the hotel before booking, or bring your own.
